input.goal: Make a no-cook sandwich using only bread, tomato and cheese already available; no stove and no shopping.

effective_context.goal: Make a no-cook sandwich using only bread, tomato and cheese already available; no stove and no shopping.

quests.title: Prepare the Base
quests.action: Cut a piece of bread into two halves and place them on a surface.
quests.completion_criteria: Bread is cut into two halves and placed on a surface.
quests.hint: Ensure the bread is evenly cut for even distribution.

quests.title: Add Tomato
quests.action: Place a slice of tomato on top of one half of the bread.
quests.completion_criteria: A slice of tomato is placed on top of one half of the bread.
quests.hint: Use a small portion of tomato to avoid overloading the sandwich.

quests.title: Add Cheese
quests.action: Place a layer of cheese on top of the tomato slice.
quests.completion_criteria: A layer of cheese is placed on top of the tomato slice.
quests.hint: Use a small amount of cheese to ensure it is evenly distributed.

quests.title: Assemble the Sandwich
quests.action: Place the other half of the bread on top of the cheese and tomato layer.
quests.completion_criteria: The sandwich is assembled with the bread, tomato, and cheese in the correct order.
quests.hint: Double-check the order to ensure the sandwich is properly constructed.

quests.title: Serve the Sandwich
quests.action: Serve the sandwich immediately after assembly.
quests.completion_criteria: The sandwich is ready to be served.
quests.hint: Ensure the sandwich is placed on a stable surface and is ready for consumption.
